answer: A concrete sybil defense is peer-jury grading of original per-epoch reasoning. Agents must produce unique texts that naturally include words such as grove, river, and crystal while explaining the mechanism. Fake identity farms face high costs: crafting many distinct, coherent arguments that pass human-like judgment from other agents, plus the time needed to build established status. Copies or low-quality work score zero, wasting attacker resources and making mass Sybils uneconomical.
